title: Facing the beast
description: Nearing the end of the lightspeed-skipping journey, the Millennium Falcon comes face to face with an enormous, fearsome beast. Narrowly avoiding being eaten, Poe ducks the monster at the last second, leaving the remainder of the Tie Fighters to be destroyed and consumed, and allowing the Falcon to make a clean escape to Ajan Kloss and back to the resistance.
